title: Passive Ownership and Price Informativeness
eligible_reason: No binary staggered TWFE specification. Table 2 regresses earnings-day price-informativeness measures on continuous lagged passive ownership with time-varying firm controls (permno + yq FE). Table 3 (S&P 500 additions and Russell reconstitutions) is IV: lpass instrumented by post x treated x predicted passive-ownership increase (continuous intensity), estimated in a stacked design with permno#cohortg FE (cohort = industry x size bucket x addition month). The reduced form (commented out, appendix) has the same continuous, stacked structure. Figures 1-2 are descriptive means.
design_notes: replication_code/t2_baseline_regressions.do: reghdfe outcome lpass $A [aw=wt], a(permno yq), $A = age lmcap calret lbm lb_mkt lr2 linst sivol stvol. t3b_S&P500.do: ivreghdfe outcome (lpass = ivinteract post), a(permno#cohortg), cluster(permno yq); +-36 months excluding +-3; control stocks are in-index and eligible-not-added stocks matched by GICS x size x addition month. t3a_Russell.do: same for Russell 1000/2000 reconstitution cohorts.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: S&P 500 additions occur at many dates, but they enter only as stacked cohorts with continuous intensity in an IV.
data_files_note: README: cleaned and merged analysis files from WRDS (CRSP, S12, 13F, OptionMetrics, IBES), FTSE Russell and Siblis are included.
screener_notes: Screened from package only. Not eligible: continuous regressor, IV, stacked cohort FE.
